moments.title: Siena Spiro holds UK #1 as all-female top six dominates
moments.blurb: Siena Spiro's 'Great Expectation' celebrates its third week at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart, leading an all-female top six for the second time in chart history.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Siena Spiro’s ‘Great Expectation’ is still holding strong at UK Number 1! Who else is loving this track?

angles.name: Female Power
angles.copy: History made! For only the second time ever, the entire UK Singles Chart Top 6 is ALL FEMALE artists this week. Siena Spiro, Ella Langley, Stella Lefty, ADÉLA, Dua Lipa, and Olivia Rodrigo are smashing it!
